analyst.summary: PCBL is India's largest carbon-black producer and a growing global player in specialty phosphonate chemicals, but the expansion into specialty chemicals has been funded with a near-five-fold increase in debt over two years, leaving interest coverage thin. Core operations look stable quarter to quarter, but returns on capital have not kept pace with the higher leverage, and the stock still trades at a rich 49-63 times trailing earnings. We recommend continuing to treat this as a Sell until the higher debt load shows through in improved returns.
